name: launch
note: The second pose of the catapult launch sequence, found with the pose editor (G2 held in the air, instant jumps) from the owner's pictures: front legs straight and tall (shoulders 20, knees 100), rear legs crouched (shoulders 70, knees -35), claw at 125 with the jaw closed. The editor's own save read the stand pose because the board started its own `up` just before it, so these are the angles the editor commanded.
